https://mastodon.social/@32bitkid@mstdn..text: Got some more progress and accuracy implemented this weekend for a HERCMONO.DRV render filter for my javascript SCI0 renderer. Reworked the CRT phosphor gen to use the wave-length emission range from the data-sheets to get a little more "accurate" projection into sRGB space. Here are simplified P1, P3, P4 phosphors, three classic phosphors for CRTs. Want to implement a phosphor glow for secondary wavelengths at some point. #RetroComputing #RetroGaming #HerculesGraphics
